scope: All 190 residual dostav-/dostaj- surface-family sites: 185 mathematical obtain/get/result uses and five genuine supply/submission uses.
choice: Move the 185 obtain/result sites to official dobyvati forms while retaining exactly five dostaviti/dostavjati supply or submission sites.

alternatives_rejected: A global dostav-to-dobyv substitution would corrupt three submission dates and two provide/supply clauses.
Retaining the obtain doublet preserves an unnecessary type-2 layer beside the now established type-1 dobyvati family.
Poluč- would restore the East-heavy terminology previously removed.
